$comment: HAND-EDITED source of the General section's Agent Chat composer rows (cx-d5b5d). scripts/cmux-next/gen-settings-sources.py writes the Swift descriptors and parser constants from it (its docstring is the row format); schemas/settings/settings-schema.json is still exported from Swift and must not change when rows move here.

lists.name: composer
lists.note: The composer's rows (General > Agent Chat, after the edited-files card's); the pane reads the same names (webviews/src/agent-session/acpmux/composerSettings.ts).

help.text: The ring beside the model that fills as the chat uses its context window.

rows.note: What the composer's ring shows (agentPane.composerRing). Leo, 2026-11-04: "i guess we can turn that into a 5h/weekly usage type thing instead as well for some people".

help.text: What the ring at the end of the composer shows: the chat's context usage, or your plan's usage limits (5-hour and weekly) when the harness reports them.

choices.note: How much of its context window the chat has used (the ring as it always was).
The account's plan usage limits (5-hour and weekly), when the harness reports them.

help.text: The microphone beside Send in every composer, including the New Tab page.
Underlines misspellings and offers system suggestions in the composer.

rows.note: How the composer and sent messages show attachments (agentPane.attachmentView). Only the look: a draft's text, its attachments and their order are the same in all.

help.text: How pictures and files show in the composer and in sent messages. Inline puts each one in the text where you added it; Strip shows them in a row. The message and its order stay the same.

choices.note: Each attachment in the text where it was added, as Messages does.
The attachments together in a row.
In the text and in the row too, so every attachment shows in one place with its remove (Leo, 2026-10-24: "ALSO show the top displayed attachments alongside the inline attachments").

rows.note: On, sending while reading up jumps to the newest row; off, sending keeps the visible row and offset while new rows arrive below it. A reader at the bottom still follows streaming output.

title.text: Scroll to Bottom When I Send

help.text: When off, sending while you are reading up keeps your place and shows new messages below.

rows.note: The Computer menu adds cached high-load or low-memory details to remote machine rows; it starts no other health poller.

help.text: Shows a warning when a remote machine is at its CPU or memory budget in the Computer menu.

rows.note: Where a new chat runs when its composer picks nothing (agentPane.newChatsIn); the page decides (runLocationDefault.ts). Leo, 2026-10-31: "whenever i start a chat it should be able to send me to cloud autommatically".

help.text: Where a new chat runs. Cloud starts it on your own Cloud machine, with your project copied there. The new chat's composer can change it for that chat.

choices.note: The person's own Cloud machine (a free one of theirs, else a new one).
